stories.headline: Bowers Saddles Up Again - Raiders' Ace Makes His Season Debut
stories.read: Well pardner, the doc's cleared ol' Brock Bowers to ride, and he's set to make his season debut down in the Big Easy against the Saints. That's the best pass-catcher in Vegas back in the saddle after knee surgery had him laid up all summer. Don't expect him wide open right out the gate, but every dollar you got tied up in him just doubled in value, and the Raiders' whole passing game just got its money patch back. Start him with confidence, and watch that touch count climb week over week.

stories.headline: Caleb Williams Nursin' a Busted Wing - Bears Ridin' Into Philly Blind
stories.read: Caleb Williams took a tumble with a Grade 2 hamstring strain, and the Bears done ruled him out for Monday's tangle with the Eagles, handin' the reins to Tyson Bagent or Case Keenum. That's a hard flag on every Bears pass-catcher you're startin' this week: a backup gunslinger means a smaller cut of the throws to go around, and DJ Moore and Rome Odunze both take a hit to their ceiling. Doc's read: bench 'em if your bench is deep enough, and don't go chasin' Bagent as a streamer unless you're plumb desperate.

stories.headline: Zay Flowers' Status Still Murkier Than the Rio Riverbed
stories.read: Ravens' Zay Flowers never got back to a full practice this week, and word out of Baltimore has him leanin' toward sittin' this one out against Dallas down in Rio. If he can't saddle up, that's fresh gold for Rashod Bateman and the rest of that receivin' corps to pan on Sunday. Doc's read: don't trust Flowers as anything better than a coin-flip flex till he's confirmed active, and stake your claim on whoever profits in Baltimore before the rest of the outfit catches wise.
